name: Levi's x Air Jordan 3 Retro SP 'Denim Blue'
story_html: Drawn from a collaborative footwear collection, the Levi's x Air Jordan 3 Retro SP 'Denim Blue' reimagines the classic silhouette with an upper that discards the traditional full leather build. Instead, the upper is cloaked in dark indigo denim with black elephant-print leather overlays at the forefoot and heel. A crimson embroidered Jumpman stands out on the black leather tongue, matching the Levi's tab that adorns the lateral side of the right shoe. Nike Air branding decorates the heel tab. A two-tone polyurethane midsole in white and black packs a visible Air-Sole unit in the heel for impact protection and a comfortable ride.
